# CANDIDATE: MARKET_STRUCTURE_SHIFT_WITH_VWAP_CONFLUENCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A market structure break (BOS/CHoCH) that coincides with a VWAP cross has higher follow‑through probability because it combines institutional order flow (VWAP) with a shift in short-term market structure, increasing the likelihood of sustained momentum in the break direction.

## Mechanism

Entry: Detect bullish BOS when price makes a new higher high and closes above the prior swing high, OR bearish BOS when price makes a new lower low and closes below the prior swing low. Simultaneously require price to cross VWAP in the same bar (price>VWAP for bullish, price<VWAP for bearish). Enter at the close of the bar in the BOS direction. Exit: Chart‑stop at the swing point that was broken (prior swing high for longs, prior swing low for shorts). TP1 at 2R (risk = entry to stop). Runner trail using EMA‑ribbon: close below 8EMA for longs, above 8EMA for shorts. Regime filter: Only enter when ADX(14)>20 and VIX<25 to avoid choppy conditions.
